section: 7.4.6.4 Scrolling to a fragment; find a potential indicated element
retrieval: Hosted web tool opened the official HTML Standard and located the indicated-element algorithm. Direct shell HTTPS was blocked by the environment proxy.
summary: Native fragment navigation first selects a matching element ID, then a matching name on an a element, in document order. A name on an h3 element alone is not a native fragment target. GitHub application behavior must still be established separately by a live browser with functioning controls.
